He was at peace, however; his eyes were closed, his face relaxed. You walked over to him, your footsteps making no noise on the carpeted ground.

Hajime opened his eyes, and you met his gaze. It was intense, piercing, as if he could see all the way to your soul. And yet, there was a gentleness to it. It was the gaze of a man who had accepted his fate.
